title: Jammy Crisp Dutch Tahini Tart
description: A paleo-friendly Dutch tart featuring a jammy filling, crispy crust, and indulgent tahini paste, all encrouted in a flaky pastry crust. This dessert is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, tahini paste, and salt.
Add the honey, egg, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough into a thin circle and place it into a 9-inch tart pan.
Spread the raspberry jam evenly over the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the jam to form a crust.
Brush the crust with the melted coconut oil.
Bake the tart for 35 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Allow the tart to cool completely before serving.
